signal_or_failure: Target sales up 44 percent and pre-tax profit up 100 percent over the previous year
what_it_demonstrated: that the company could print a doubling of unit profit in its own report for its own year
what_it_did_not_demonstrate: nothing: no dollars, no base, no store-level breakdown, no auditor and no outside count are held for the unit in this period
notes: the only Target-unit dollar printed anywhere in FY1962-FY1968 is FY1967's 86,901,007

signal_or_failure: 51 percent of women customers in Hennepin County shopped a Target store
magnitude: 51 percent of a county's women customers
what_it_demonstrated: adoption depth in the home metro, as reported by a newspaper survey the company chose to quote
what_it_did_not_demonstrate: market share, sales, whether the survey defined shopped as entered, or anything outside one county
notes: survey NOT HELD; one carrier deep (UNTRIED-4)

signal_or_failure: Two new stores opened in October and operated at a profit for the year after absorbing all pre-opening expenses
magnitude: 2 stores, profitable in year of opening
what_it_demonstrated: that the format paid back inside its first partial year on the company's own accounting statement
what_it_did_not_demonstrate: the margin, the dollar amount, or whether the statement is auditable outside the report

signal_or_failure: First out-of-market test: two Denver stores open
what_it_demonstrated: that the company could build and open away from home
what_it_did_not_demonstrate: repeatability beyond one market; FY1967's claim that Denver matched home performance is the company restating itself
notes: UNVERIFIED TLS; the first genuine outside-market result is a retrospective sentence in the next year's report
